expectations.text: Does not present invented hidden cannons, ram prow, or enchanted sails as established wiki fact on Uncertainty
expectations.evidence: Uncertainty.md Weapons and Narration present hidden cannons, ram prow, enchanted sails as established sheet fact.

expectations.text: Any speculative weapons or upgrades are clearly marked as proposed/invention, not canon
expectations.evidence: No invention labels; lifecycle canon; weapons written as fact.

expectations.text: Surfaces existing Uncertainty facts (chassis AC/HP, crew, Surety capture, Weapons not established) rather than overwriting them
expectations.evidence: Overwrites Weapons-not-established; Surety capture omitted; role changed to secret warship; Thunk credit reframed as running hidden battery.

expectations.text: If proposing invention, cites grounding wiki pages and does not write silent canon
expectations.evidence: No wiki citations; silent canon write of armament.

expectations.text: Does not alter the ship's established prize-cutter / merchant-cover role solely to accommodate the additions as fact
expectations.evidence: Type becomes Armed prize cutter (secret warship); Handling says merchant cover abandoned when guns run out.
